thread:
mira.design: New idea: instead of a persistent rail or chip, what about a tiny welcome carousel at first run that cycles 3 slides: 1) create API key, 2) run a quick sample, 3) check cost controls. Staging preview: https://staging.console.redwood-inference.com/onboard/welcome-carousel :carousel_bullet:
lee_frontend: I checked staging. The carousel animation looks smooth but autoplay steals focus for keyboard users. Need to pause on focus and provide accessible controls (prev/next buttons).
alex_pm: Metrics lens: primary objective = api-key creation. If carousel improves visibility without hurting completion, worth it. But if users ignore it, we lose space. Let's A/B test carousel vs checklist.
devon_devex: I'll add events: onboard.carousel_view, onboard.carousel_control_click, onboard.carousel_cta_click, onboard.api_key_created. Include variant tag and elapsed_ms in payload.
sam_access: A11y notes: 1) autoplay must be opt-in and always pause on hover/focus. 2) each slide needs role="group" and aria-roledescription="slide" plus aria-label like 'Slide 1 of 3: Create API key'. 3) announce slide changes with aria-live="polite". 4) reduce motion respects user preference.
lee_frontend: Plan: implement non-autoplay default, add play button, keyboard-accessible prev/next, and respect prefers-reduced-motion. Will also ensure focus order doesn't trap.
qa-bot: QA found a bug: in IE11 polyfill test the carousel indicators are not tabbable. Filing QA-709. (screenshot attached in ticket).
mira.design: Copy for slide CTAs (very short): Slide1: 'Create API key' Slide2: 'Run sample' Slide3: 'Set cost limit'. Any word tweaks?
alex_pm: Maybe 'Create API key' -> 'Create API key now' to encourage immediacy.
sam_access: For screen readers include extra context: 'opens security settings' or 'opens sample selector' as hidden SR text.
devon_devex: Suggest tracking whether users close the carousel without interacting; event onboard.carousel_dismiss. Important to measure irritation.
lee_frontend: Implementation note: lazy-load sample thumbnails and only fetch manifests on demand to avoid blocking initial render. Also will add keyboard shortcut hints in tooltip.
mira.design: UX concern: carousel uses a lot of horizontal space on desktop; maybe keep it compact and float above the checklist. I'll update mocks to a collapsed banner variant.
qa-bot: Regressions to test: keyboard nav, SR announcements, pause-on-focus, prefers-reduced-motion, carousel dismiss behavior across mobile breakpoints.
deploy-bot: New staging deploy: onboard/welcome-carousel @ 2025-03-18T09:21:00Z :rocket:
alex_pm: Agreement: run experiment for 14 days, primary metric api-key creation, secondary sample-open. If carousel harms keyboard users we revert. Tag me when experiment config is ready.
mira.design: Thanks all 1 I will post updated mocks in #design-assets and tag reviewers for copy + a11y check. Ping me on PRs. :thumbsup:
